control_publication.temporary_creation: open the sibling temporary path with O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC; fstat the descriptor as one regular file; never create the committed target directly
control_publication.commit_primitive: on the frozen Darwin formal runtime call libc renamex_np(<target>.publishing,<target>,RENAME_EXCL) with RENAME_EXCL=0x00000004; source and target are siblings in the same parent directory; return 0 is the only successful no-replace commit, EEXIST selects race_target, and every other errno fails closed
control_publication.write_order: write all expected bytes and verify the full byte count through the opened temporary descriptor, fsync that descriptor, retain its fstat st_dev/st_ino, atomically rename the temporary to the committed target with commit_primitive, open the final target O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC and fstat/read the same descriptor, require exact bytes and the same st_dev/st_ino as the still-open pre-rename temporary descriptor, fsync the final descriptor and parent; no pathname unlink is performed
control_publication.committed_definition: only the final target path is committed; a .publishing path is never authority
control_publication.existing_target: inspect with no-follow lstat/open/fstat and accept only a regular non-symlink final target whose bytes are exactly the independently derived expected bytes; a sibling temporary may be absent or an exact regular non-authority race residue and is preserved, while a mismatched or nonregular temporary fails closed; quarantine inventory may contain zero or more canonical content-addressed regular artifacts, each byte hash must equal its path SHA suffix and ordinals for each SHA must be contiguous from zero; callers must not resolve the final path component before publication or validation
control_publication.quarantine_rule: pathname unlink is forbidden. While holding the orchestrator flock, mechanically validate the complete quarantine inventory, open and retain the verified regular abandoned temporary FD identity and exact SHA256, select ordinal equal to the current contiguous count for that SHA, move its pathname atomically to quarantine_path with renamex_np(...,RENAME_EXCL), reopen quarantine O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC and require regular kind, the same st_dev/st_ino as the retained FD, exact retained bytes and matching SHA/ordinal suffix, fsync quarantine and parent, preserve it permanently as non-authority evidence, then rebuild only when expected bytes are independently derivable. Any invalid inventory, post-rename mismatch or no-follow observation failure fails closed without overwrite or rebuild
control_publication.abandoned_deterministic_temporary: with target absent, resume an exact regular temporary through commit_primitive; quarantine a truncated or mismatched regular temporary through quarantine_rule, then rebuild from independently derived bytes
control_publication.abandoned_observational_temporary: for PUSH_CALL or child-exit bytes that cannot be reconstructed after interruption, quarantine the uncommitted regular temporary only after the corresponding runtime lock is acquirable; select REF_OBSERVATION or interruption semantics instead
control_publication.claim_payloads: attempt lock and invocation claims are deterministic payloads published by this same protocol; the successful atomic no-replace rename, not temporary creation, consumes the claim
control_publication.tracked_copy: publish the exact source receipt bytes through a sibling temporary and the same atomic no-replace rename order
control_publication.fd_identity: all existing-target, race-target, temporary and quarantine verification uses O_NOFOLLOW plus lstat/fstat and descriptor reads; after a successful rename the final descriptor must identify the same st_dev/st_ino as the still-open pre-rename temporary descriptor; pathname exists/is_file/read_bytes, pathname unlink and resolving the final component are forbidden authority
control_publication.race_target: if commit_primitive returns EEXIST, reopen the final target O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC and reclassify through existing_target. Accept only exact regular target bytes. Preserve an exact regular temporary as non-authority race evidence; a mismatched or nonregular target or temporary fails closed without unlink, rewrite or retry
control_publication.crash_interpretation: crash before successful no-replace rename leaves only an uncommitted temporary; crash after success leaves the committed target and no temporary name because rename is atomic; EEXIST may leave an exact committed target plus an exact regular non-authority temporary race residue

every other ref tuple -> UNREADABLE and do not run object or blob commands

local_path_state_derivation: lstat ENOENT -> ABSENT; another lstat error -> OBSERVATION_ERROR with LSTAT errno
lstat symlink, directory, FIFO or another nonregular kind -> the corresponding nonregular state without open
for lstat regular, open O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC; any open error -> OBSERVATION_ERROR with OPEN errno
fstat the opened descriptor; fstat error, nonregular result or st_dev/st_ino mismatch against lstat -> OBSERVATION_ERROR with FSTAT errno, using errno 0 for kind or identity mismatch
read the complete descriptor bytes; read error -> OBSERVATION_ERROR with READ errno

state, SHA256 and observation_error are emitted by this ordered function for target and temporary independently
quarantine_state_derivation: list the parent directory through one opened no-follow directory descriptor and select every sibling beginning exactly <target-name>.abandoned.
zero selected names -> ABSENT with quarantine_inventory_json containing empty entries_hex and rows arrays
for every selected raw basename in byte order, append its name_hex and emit exactly one row under quarantine_inventory_row_schema
a name that does not match <target-name>.abandoned.<64-lowercase-hex>.<base-10-nonnegative-ordinal-with-no-leading-zero-except-zero> emits NONCANONICAL_NAME and is not opened

for a canonical name apply the ordered no-follow lstat/open/fstat/read function: direct lstat nonregular kinds emit their exact kind; readable identity-stable regular bytes emit VALID_REGULAR when content SHA256 equals the path suffix and INVALID_REGULAR otherwise; the first syscall, kind-after-open or inode-identity failure emits OBSERVATION_ERROR
any OBSERVATION_ERROR row or parent listing failure -> OBSERVATION_ERROR and quarantine_observation_error binds the first error in the frozen order
otherwise any NONCANONICAL_NAME, INVALID_REGULAR or nonregular row -> INVALID_INVENTORY
otherwise group VALID_REGULAR rows by sha256_suffix and require ordinals exactly 0..count-1 with no duplicate path or ordinal; violation -> INVALID_INVENTORY
otherwise -> VALID_INVENTORY; therefore every VALID_INVENTORY row is VALID_REGULAR with observed_sha256=sha256_suffix and contiguous per-SHA ordinals

stage_profile_rules: committed terminal receipt -> exact completed_stages_json and missing_stages_json already in that receipt
verifier exit committed and resolved classification is FAIL -> FAIL_CLASSIFIED_WITH_PROCESS_RECEIPTS
verifier exit=0 and accepted package plus baseline publication are complete -> PASS_COMPLETE
first_error_rules_in_precedence_order: committed terminal receipt exists -> its immutable first_error
producer exit tuple terminal_error is FORMAL_PRODUCER_LAUNCH_ERROR, FORMAL_PRODUCER_HANDOFF_ERROR or FORMAL_PRODUCER_EXIT_NONZERO -> that producer terminal_error regardless of later verifier state
verifier exit tuple terminal_error is TERMINAL_VERIFIER_LAUNCH_ERROR, TERMINAL_VERIFIER_HANDOFF_ERROR, TERMINAL_VERIFIER_INTERNAL_ERROR or TERMINAL_VERIFIER_UNEXPECTED_EXIT -> that terminal_error
verifier exit=2 -> exact registered verifier first_error
verifier exit=0 with accepted result -> NONE
resolver_cases: producer invocation absent -> first_error FORMAL_ORCHESTRATOR_INTERRUPTED_PRE_PRODUCER, profile FAIL_PRE_PRODUCER
producer invocation committed and producer exit absent -> first_error FORMAL_PRODUCER_INTERRUPTED, profile FAIL_PRODUCER_INTERRUPTED
producer exit resolves to a producer terminal_error and verifier invocation absent -> preserve producer terminal_error, profile FAIL_PRE_VERIFIER
producer exit=0 and verifier invocation absent -> first_error FORMAL_ORCHESTRATOR_INTERRUPTED_PRE_VERIFIER, profile FAIL_PRE_VERIFIER
producer exit resolves to a producer terminal_error and verifier invocation committed but verifier exit absent -> preserve producer terminal_error, profile FAIL_VERIFIER_INTERRUPTED
producer exit=0 and verifier invocation committed but verifier exit absent -> first_error TERMINAL_VERIFIER_INTERRUPTED, profile FAIL_VERIFIER_INTERRUPTED
producer exit resolves to a producer terminal_error and verifier exit is committed with any legal verifier tuple -> preserve producer terminal_error, profile FAIL_CLASSIFIED_WITH_PROCESS_RECEIPTS
producer exit=0 and verifier exit resolves to a verifier terminal_error -> use verifier terminal_error, profile FAIL_CLASSIFIED_WITH_PROCESS_RECEIPTS
producer exit=0 and verifier exit=2 -> use registered verifier first_error, profile FAIL_CLASSIFIED_WITH_PROCESS_RECEIPTS

producer exit=0 and verifier exit=0 with accepted result -> first_error NONE; PASS_COMPLETE only after exact baseline publication, otherwise continue PASS recovery without publishing a premature terminal receipt

crash_token_resolution.RESOLVE_FROM_DURABLE_STATE: apply first_error_rules_in_precedence_order and stage_profile_rules to committed invocation and exit receipts; after verifier exit=0 but before baseline publication this resolves to PASS recovery only when producer also succeeded, otherwise to FAIL_CLASSIFIED_WITH_PROCESS_RECEIPTS
crash_token_resolution.FROM_COMMITTED_TERMINAL_RECEIPT: use immutable classification, first_error, completed_stages_json and missing_stages_json from the committed terminal receipt

terminal_state_resolver.result_totality: first apply artifact_state_machine A01-A12 in order; every valid non-controller-blocked durable artifact combination resolves to one PASS or FAIL terminal tuple, while the first invalid rule deterministically enters ARTIFACT_STATE_CORRUPTION with classification/profile NONE

formal_process_receipts.invocation_semantics: acquire runtime flock, atomically publish the deterministic invocation claim, then call Popen exactly once; committed invocation existence consumes the sole launch right even if Popen fails; recovery never launches a child whose invocation claim exists and never creates a missing invocation claim
formal_process_receipts.durability: atomically publish the exit receipt immediately after child waitpid or Popen error using control_publication

recovery_start_value_domains.recovery_id: SHA256 of canonical compact sorted-key ASCII JSON over the other six fields excluding recovery_id

recovery.recovery_start_rule: on every legal controller-ref path derive canonical recovery_start bytes from the unchanged snapshot, create or verify recovery_start_witness in the controller bare repository, then publish the exact witnessed bytes locally before rename, commit, tag, ledger-ref push, receipt copy, child-state classification, baseline publication or terminalization; every restart reuses the exact witnessed bytes and original crash_boundary; all workflow_blockers codes are exceptions and follow workflow_blocker_restart_rows without creating a new recovery_start

recovery_start_witness.object_type: the witness ref points directly to one Git blob whose bytes are exactly canonical recovery_start.json including final LF
recovery_start_witness.diagnostic_observation_order: run ref_observe_command exactly once; when it emits one 40-hex OID run object_type_command exactly once; only when type is blob run blob_read_command exactly once; record every executed exit code and exact stdout/stderr SHA256 in recovery_witness_evidence_json
recovery_start_witness.publication_order: derive bytes from unchanged snapshot; hash bytes independently as a Git blob; write the blob; create witness_ref CAS from all-zero old OID; fsync controller repository and parent; verify ref object type blob and exact blob bytes; only then create or reconcile local recovery_start.json temporary/target

restart_matrix.ref_absent_target_absent_temporary_absen: derive from unchanged snapshot, create witness, then publish local target
restart_matrix.ref_absent_any_local_recovery_start_path: target, temporary or quarantine present before witness publishes or verifies ARTIFACT_STATE_CORRUPTION with first_invalid_rule A12_RECOVERY_WITNESS_MISMATCH; local publication is forbidden before witness
restart_matrix.ref_exact_target_absent_temporary_absent: witness bytes are authority; quarantine must be ABSENT or VALID_INVENTORY; create and fsync a new exact regular temporary, then commit with atomic no-replace rename
restart_matrix.ref_exact_target_absent_temporary_exact_: open temporary O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC, fstat regular, verify exact witnessed bytes and retain st_dev/st_ino, fsync the same descriptor, atomically rename it no-replace to target, then reopen target O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC and require regular kind, exact witnessed bytes and the same st_dev/st_ino; fsync final descriptor and parent; successful rename leaves no temporary pathname

if no-replace rename returns EEXIST, reopen target no-follow and reclassify through ref_exact_target_exact_regular; accept only exact regular witnessed target bytes and preserve the exact regular temporary as non-authority race evidence, otherwise publish A12 without unlink or rewrite
restart_matrix.ref_exact_target_absent_temporary_mismat: quarantine must be ABSENT or VALID_INVENTORY; hash the no-follow verified regular temporary bytes, choose the next contiguous ordinal for that SHA, atomically move it to the content-addressed quarantine path with RENAME_EXCL, reopen and verify inode/bytes/suffix, fsync parent, preserve it permanently, then rebuild from witnessed bytes; invalid inventory or any observation mismatch is A12
restart_matrix.ref_exact_target_absent_temporary_nonreg: publish or verify ARTIFACT_STATE_CORRUPTION with first_invalid_rule A12_RECOVERY_WITNESS_MISMATCH; do not unlink or rewrite
restart_matrix.ref_exact_target_exact_regular: accept after no-follow descriptor verification against witness; temporary ABSENT is the successful-rename state, exact regular temporary is a preserved EEXIST race residue, and every other temporary state is A12; quarantine may be ABSENT or VALID_INVENTORY and every other quarantine state is A12; never unlink or rewrite temporary or quarantine
restart_matrix.ref_exact_target_mismatch_or_nonregular: publish or verify ARTIFACT_STATE_CORRUPTION with first_invalid_rule A12_RECOVERY_WITNESS_MISMATCH; never rewrite target or witness
restart_matrix.ref_invalid_type_or_unreadable_or_confli: freeze recovery_witness_evidence_json, publish or verify ARTIFACT_STATE_CORRUPTION with first_invalid_rule A12_RECOVERY_WITNESS_MISMATCH, then follow workflow_blocker_restart_rows; controller mutation, recovery-start/observation publication, terminalization and baseline mutation are forbidden, while blocker publication and deterministic local claim consumption are the only allowed writes

recovery_start_witness.a12_blocker_boundary: every A12 path freezes recovery_witness_evidence_json in artifact_state_corruption.json before any claim rename, commit or tag. After that receipt commits, workflow_blocker_restart_rows are the sole restart authority. No observed recovery_start.json is accepted as recovery authority and no new recovery-start target is created; no recovery_observation or terminal artifact is created, and no controller ref is written

qa_artifact_state_domains.file_state_derivation: apply recovery_witness_evidence_schema.local_path_state_derivation independently to each terminal/recovery file using its registered expected schema/bytes; VALID_REGULAR means exact valid canonical bytes, INVALID_REGULAR means regular readable bytes that fail validation, and nonregular/error states preserve no-follow kind or first syscall error
qa_artifact_state_domains.sha_binding: for each file-state/SHA256 pair, VALID_REGULAR or INVALID_REGULAR requires the exact no-follow raw-file SHA256; ABSENT, every nonregular kind and OBSERVATION_ERROR require SHA256=NONE
qa_artifact_state_domains.error_binding: each *_error field is NONE unless its state=OBSERVATION_ERROR; then it is the exact first failing LSTAT|OPEN|FSTAT|READ stage plus base-10 errno, using FSTAT:0 for kind or inode-identity mismatch
qa_artifact_state_domains.witness_observation_policy: at every terminal or blocker QA handoff, including a normal path that never entered recovery, run the exact recovery_start_witness ref_observe_command once and then the registered object-type/blob-read commands exactly when selected by ref_state_derivation; omission is a QA schema failure and is not an artifact state
qa_artifact_state_domains.witness_observation_json_binding: recovery_witness_observation_json is canonical compact sorted-key ASCII JSON containing exactly blob_read_exit_code, blob_read_stderr_sha256, blob_read_stdout_sha256, object_type, object_type_exit_code, object_type_stderr_sha256, object_type_stdout_sha256, observed_oid, ref_observation_exit_code, ref_observation_stderr_sha256, ref_observation_stdout_sha256, ref_state, witness_blob_oid and witness_ref, with values derived by recovery_witness_evidence_schema.ref_state_derivation and value_domains
qa_artifact_state_domains.witness_binding: recovery_witness_ref always equals the exact registered witness ref and recovery_witness_state equals recovery_witness_observation_json.ref_state; EXACT_BLOB or CONFLICTING_BLOB requires recovery_witness_blob_oid equal the observed 40-hex blob OID, and ABSENT, INVALID_OBJECT_TYPE or UNREADABLE requires recovery_witness_blob_oid=NONE

qa_workflow_outcome_modes.TERMINAL: workflow_blocker_code=NONE, workflow_blocker_sha256=NONE, first_invalid_rule=NONE, terminal result and terminal transition receipt states are both VALID_REGULAR, classification is the immutable PASS/FAIL classification, and recovery_evidence_state is NOT_STARTED or COMPLETE
qa_workflow_outcome_modes.ARTIFACT_BLOCKED: workflow_blocker_code=ARTIFACT_STATE_CORRUPTION, workflow_blocker_sha256 is exact, classification=NONE and first_invalid_rule is one A01-A12 or G02-G07 rule; A12 additionally requires a valid embedded recovery_witness_evidence_json but does not alter recovery_evidence_state
qa_workflow_outcome_modes.CONTROLLER_BLOCKED: workflow_blocker_code is CONTROLLER_REF_DIVERGENCE or CONTROLLER_OBSERVATION_FAILURE and workflow_blocker_sha256 is exact; classification preserves the immutable terminal classification only when terminal_result_receipt_state=VALID_REGULAR and is NONE otherwise; first_invalid_rule is G01_CONTROLLER_REF_NOT_EXPECTED for divergence and NONE for observation failure

ordered_partition: NOT_STARTED when recovery_witness_state=ABSENT and both recovery file states are ABSENT
WITNESS_ONLY when recovery_witness_state=EXACT_BLOB and both recovery file states are ABSENT
START_ONLY when recovery_witness_state=EXACT_BLOB, recovery_start_state=VALID_REGULAR and recovery_observation_state=ABSENT
COMPLETE when recovery_witness_state=EXACT_BLOB and both recovery file states are VALID_REGULAR, the blob bytes equal recovery_start.json and recovery_observation binds its SHA256
